problem:
The row echelon form matrix $B$ is given below. What are its **non**-pivot columns?

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}3 & -8 & 0 & 4 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 7 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

feedback.problem:
The row echelon form matrix $R$ is given below. What are its **non**-pivot columns?

$$
R=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 9 & -8 & 6 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $R$ has $3$ pivots in the $1$st, $2$nd, and $3$rd columns:

$$
R=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 9 & -8 & 6 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the only non-pivot column is the $4$th column.
